about_the_game:
You are trapped in an endlessly repeating casino. The only way to escape is to observe your surroundings and find the Anomalies.

This game is a first-person psychological horror puzzle adventure. Everything in the casino is newly reconstructed each time. You must find changes like misplaced objects, swapped signs, or subtly altered appearances of people, and use them to find the true exit before an anomaly occurs.

Don't miss even the slightest oddity. If you miss a single change and choose the wrong exit, time will reset to 2 AM. Can you choose the right exit to end this bizarre night and escape safely?

Key Features:

  • Unique Observation-Based Gameplay: A puzzle element where you find anomalies and choose the right exit.

  • A Changing Casino Environment: The fun of exploring a bizarre space that changes with every loop.

  • Escalating Psychological Horror: The thrill of a constant, oppressive presence and an environment that can change at any moment.
